**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

- The only MFN mechanic in the document is in § 6 (p0047) and runs **in our favour**: TrueLink's Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," with a one-year price freeze.
- No reciprocal obligation exists anywhere: § 5 (compensation), § 2–4 (licence/hosting/support), and § 8 (Client covenants) contain no requirement for Client to extend TrueLink best terms, disclose third-party terms, or match third-party offers. The § 2(a) language expressly confirms Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other" comparable software or services, so there is no back-door MFN or exclusivity pull-through.
- No redline proposed — the Vendor-granted MFN is a benefit we keep.
